# 上清眾經諸真聖祕

**Base edition:** HFL

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An eight-*juàn* systematic survey-pantheon of all the Shàngqīng 上清 spirits and deities, compiled from the writings of that school and presented in tabular form. Probably intended for ritual purposes.

**Abstract**

Dated by Robinet (Schipper & Verellen, *Taoist Canon* 1: 604–605, DZ 446) to the second half of the Táng at the earliest. The text at 8.12a cites Liángqiū zǐ's 梁丘子 (Bái Lǚzhōng 白履忠) commentary on the *Huángtíng jīng* (preserved in DZ 263 *Xiūzhēn shíshū* 55–60; cf. DZ 402 = [KR5b0086](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0086)) — which was composed *ca.* 722–729 — establishing a firm *terminus post quem* within the Táng.

The pantheon is organised as a catalogue of names with corresponding talismans (*fú* 符) giving graphic form to the deities. Despite frequent cross-references intended to avoid repetition, certain names recur in several listings. Material from DZ 166 *Yuánshǐ shàngzhēn zhòngxiānjì* 元始上真眾仙記 is included at 5.3a–6b, and some Língbǎo divinities also figure (7.12a).

The text is an indispensable reference for the working out of the late-Táng Shàngqīng pantheon, and a major source for the systematic naming-apparatus of the later Daoist ritual tradition.
